column1: # Per-case mean-distance ceilings at full resolution (`--blocks 1`), the gate that
# Both numbers come from measurement, not from a hunch: `book#1` measured 3.677
# mean without anti-aliasing and 2.578 with it, so 3.2 sits between them with ~20%
# headroom for the renderer with AA and a clear failure for one without. Only the
# cases where curves and glyph edges decide the image are listed — the flat
# fixtures are already at zero, and `annotations#1` is dominated by a missing
# annotation border rather than by AA.
# Raise a ceiling deliberately, in its own commit, with the reason.
